# Docker Hub

Docker Hub is a service provided by Docker for finding and sharing container images with your team.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/docker-hub/.

## Actions

- **Add Organization Member**: Send an invitation for a user to join a Docker Hub organization.
- **Create Docker Hub Organization**: Create a Docker Hub organization.
- **Create Docker Hub Repository**: Create a Docker Hub repository under a namespace.
- **Create Docker Hub Webhook**: Create a webhook on a Docker Hub repository.
- **Delete Docker Hub Organization**: Delete a specific Docker Hub organization.
- **Delete Docker Hub Repository**: Delete a specific Docker Hub repository.
- **Delete Docker Hub repository webhook**: Delete a specific webhook from a repository.
- **Delete Docker Hub Team**: Delete a specific team from an organization.
- **Delete Repository Image**: Delete a specific image within a Docker Hub repository.
- **Delete Repository Tag**: Delete a specific tag from a Docker Hub repository.
- **Get Docker Hub Image** (read-only): Retrieve detailed information about a specific image within a Docker Hub repository.
- **Get Docker Hub Repository** (read-only): Retrieve details of a specific Docker Hub repository.
- **Get Docker Hub Tag** (read-only): Retrieve details of a specific Docker Hub repository tag.
- **Get Docker Hub Team** (read-only): Retrieve a specific Docker Hub team.
- **Get Docker Hub Webhook** (read-only): Retrieve details of a specific Docker Hub webhook.
- **Get Organization Details** (read-only): Retrieve details of a specific organization namespace.
- **List Docker Hub Organization Members** (read-only): List members of a Docker Hub organization.
- **List Docker Hub Organizations** (read-only): List organizations (namespaces) for the authenticated user.
- **List Docker Hub Repositories** (read-only): List repositories under a namespace.
- **List Docker Hub repository webhooks** (read-only): List webhooks for a Docker Hub repository.
- **List Organization Teams** (read-only): List teams in a specific organization.
- **List Repository Images** (read-only): List image variants for a specific Docker Hub repository.
- **List Repository Tags** (read-only): List tags for a Docker Hub repository.
- **List Team Members** (read-only): List members of a Docker Hub team.
- **Remove Organization Member**: Remove a user from a Docker Hub organization.
- **Remove Team Member**: Remove a user from a Docker Hub team.
